scientific_integrity: Prior compactness, nonhyponormality, and Schatten classification credited; only infinite positive and negative inertia claimed here. Priority is qualified by unindexed literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Positive real row weights with second-order ratio asymptotics, exponent greater than one. Signed spectral inertia only; neither eigenvalue growth law nor complex or more irregular weights classified. The analytic proof and finite checker are not independent validation.
title: Infinite two-sided commutator inertia of compact power-decaying Rhaly operators
